content:
[Intro]
[E5]

[Verse 1]
[E5]I was an ho-
nest boy, yeah
I was brought up right
Fell for an ho-
nest girl, yeah
We were so tight
If only
luck was al-
ways on our side

[Verse 2]
[E5]You gave in all
your secrets
Didn't give in mine
Nowhere left
to run, no
We live to shine
If only love
was on your side
[G5]And I was just a stran-
[D5]ger passing by

[Chorus]
[E5]

[Verse 3]
[E5]You saw me driv-
ing my car
Like a dog running
wild
Oh my hands
were shaking
Singing, "where are you
now?"
I wish I
could go back some-
how
[G5]Just tell me ba-
[D5]by, where are you

[Chorus]
[E5]now?
Where are you
now?

[Bridge]
[C5]I've tasted eve-
[A5]ry person
[B5]don't taste like
[E5]you
[C5]You're a teardrop
[A5]in an ocean
[B5]Still we're drinking through
[E5]And
[C5]I still wonder
[A5]where you are
[B5]and who you're talk-
[E5]ing to
[C5]When I think a-
[A5]bout it I
[B5]can't move
[E5]Where are you
[C5]now?
[A5]
[B5]
[E5]Where are you
[C5]now?
[A5]
[B5]
Yeah!

[Outro]
[E5]
title: Where Are You Now
tuning: E A D G B E
